summary: Apartment: plumbing shifted to the tenant (multi-unit, so void) and both deposit deadlines too long.

findings.quote: Tenant is responsible for all plumbing repairs inside the Premises, including pipes, drains, water lines, and fixtures, regardless of cause
Landlord will maintain the roof, exterior walls, and building systems other than plumbing.
findings.note: restates the plumbing shift from the landlord's side

findings.quote: the deposit will be returned within 45 days after the lease ends
Landlord will send written notice within 60 days after the lease ends

nearMisses.quote: allowing Tenant 5 days, excluding Saturday, Sunday, and legal holidays, to pay or surrender possession
